A recent study found that prerecorded lecture VODcasts do not significantly impact the attendance of first-year pre-clinical Graduate Entry to Medicine (GEM) students at live lectures. The study concluded that most students viewed these videos as useful revision tools rather than as a replacement for live lectures, which are typically an essential part of medical education.

In other words, while VODcasts can be a valuable resource for students to review material before classes or during breaks, they do not seem to have a significant impact on attendance at live lectures.
